entries.text: SAS down 2-0, Game 3 at home. Home crowd buys them one win — they cash it tonight.
NYK stole Game 1. Expect SAS to answer back at home and even the series 1-1 before the road trip.
Game 1 at SAS. First quarter sets the tone, fourth quarter locks it in — SAS by 7.
Closeout time for OKC. They've been the better team for four games. They'll be the better team for one more.
Pivot game in OKC. The role players have figured out the matchups by now — OKC's bench tilts this one.
CLE is the lower seed playing the favorite. Eventually math wins, and tonight is eventually. NYK ends it.
OKC up 2-1 visiting SAS. Going down 3-1 ends seasons — SAS fights it off tonight.
NYK 2-0 to CLE's building. Roles flip on the road — CLE takes Game 3 and a deep breath.
1-1 series, swing back to SAS. Home Game 3 is the loudest tip of the playoffs — SAS rides it.
NYK hosting back-to-back. They cash both — CLE heads home down 0-2.
OKC lost Game 1 at home. They wake up angry — Game 2 by 11.
Game 1 at NYK. First quarter sets the tone, fourth quarter locks it in — NYK by 7.
SAS at OKC, Game 1. Series openers favor the team with the better bench. OKC's second unit shows up tonight.
None 3-3, walking into a closeout. The locker-room mood is 'finish.' The scoreboard agrees.
CLE has the closeout look. DET's season ends tonight, probably in the fourth quarter.
Pivot game in DET. The role players have figured out the matchups by now — DET's bench tilts this one.
Game 5 of a 2-2 series at SAS. Whoever wins this one wins the series 82% of the time — and SAS grabs the wheel.
OKC's starters get a 30-minute night, the bench gets the rest, and the series gets a closing time.
PHI is one loss from a long summer. NYK smells it and finishes by 12.
CLE down 2-0 at home. The home Game 3 in this spot is a coin flip — and CLE flips heads.
SAS at MIN, Game 3, series tied. Adjustments are MIN's to make at home — they make 'em, they win.
DET 1-0, hosting Game 2. Stars get their rest in the fourth — DET by double digits.
Game 2 at PHI, series 0-1. The home team in this spot wins 75%+ historically — PHI keeps the trend.
DET home for Game 1. Series openers are won at the free-throw line — DET gets the calls and the win.
Opener at NYK. Playoff atmosphere is its own player — NYK starts plus-12 before tipoff.
Closeout night for None. The hardest game to win is supposed to be the fourth one — they got the memo and finish it tonight.
ORL up 3-2 and closing teams don't blink. Book it — ORL finishes the job.
NYK has the closeout look. ATL's season ends tonight, probably in the fourth quarter.
DET faces elimination against ORL. Desperation buys one game, not four — ORL closes it out tonight.
BOS up 3-1 and closing teams don't blink. Book it — BOS finishes the job.
